content.short: Morse, formerly Sling Money, is a global payments app for instant, near-free peer-to-peer transfers using stablecoins on Solana.
content.description: Morse, formerly Sling Money, is a global payments app that lets people send money almost anywhere instantly and at near-zero cost using stablecoins under the hood. When users deposit local currency, Morse converts it into stablecoins such as Paxos' USDP and Circle's EURC on the Solana blockchain for settlement, then converts back to local currency on the other side, so recipients simply receive money without touching crypto. Users can also move supported stablecoins to and from external Solana wallets or exchanges, connecting on-chain assets with everyday fiat. Holding MiCA and FCA approvals and live in the US and Europe, Morse targets a mass-market audience, working to make global transfers as easy as sending a message.
content.meta: Morse enables instant, near-free global transfers using Solana stablecoins. Discover Morse and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
